custom_logic_notes: Entry/exit logic is entirely encapsulated in the CDC_PL_MFI custom signal filter class from ACDC_PL_MFI.mqh. The signal uses a threshold-based voting system (ThresholdOpen=10, ThresholdClose=10) with Weight=1.0. The exact crossover/comparison logic between MFI and its MA cannot be determined without inspecting the .mqh file. The EA uses the standard MQL5 Expert Advisor framework (CExpert) with no trailing stop and fixed-lot money management. Expert_EveryTick=false means signals are evaluated once per bar, not on every tick.
python_conversion_notes: The CDC_PL_MFI signal filter from ACDC_PL_MFI.mqh must be manually inspected and reimplemented in Python. It likely compares MFI values against their MA to generate buy/sell signals. Use pandas_ta or ta library for MFI calculation (period=49) and apply SMA (period=11) on the MFI output. The CExpertSignal threshold mechanism (open at 10, close at 10) with weight 1.0 simplifies to: go long when MFI > MA(MFI), go short when MFI < MA(MFI). SL/TP are fixed at 50 points which may need 5-digit adjustment (multiply by 10 for _Point=0.00001). The bar-once evaluation (EveryTick=false) means using bar-close prices, not intrabar ticks. Pending order expiration of 4 bars needs mapping to a time-based expiry or bar-count mechanism in Python.
